questions.question: What's the cadence for shipping these fixes?

options.label: Commit #15 now, then keep going
options.description: Land #15 as its own commit on this branch + ff to main, then start #16. Per-bug commits keep the history bisectable and let you ship incremental fixes.

options.label: Batch all P0s into one commit
options.description: Fix #16, #17, #7 first; commit + ff once when all 4 P0s pass. Fewer commits, but bigger blast radius if any regresses.

options.label: Commit #15 + stop, hand back review
options.description: Land #15 only, pause for your review of the approach before I dive into the rest. Safest if you want eyes on the as-of semantics shift.

options.label: Keep going, commit when natural
options.description: I decide commit boundaries as I go (likely per-bug or per-area). You see the result at the end.

transcript_tail.text: Starting on **P0 #15** (`availableToBorrow` goes negative for past asOf). #15 and #16 likely share a fix site (the as-of date filtering), so I want to read the test first to nail down the contract.

Found the bug — `availableToBorrow()` reads OWN at `$asOf` but reads outstanding **as of now** (via the `account_credit_lines.outstanding_shares` snapshot column). Need to confirm `allSharesAsOf` already gives us a BOR row to use instead.
Applying the fix — read BOR aggregate at `$asOf` instead of summing current `outstanding_shares`.
Now verifying the fix passes #15 and doesn't break adjacent tests.
#15 passes + adjacent tests stable. Quick check of #16 since both are as-of-related.

#15 is fixed (test passes, 35 adjacent tests still green). #16 still failing — same area but a separate view-level bug.

**Diff for #15** (`OutstandingCalculator::availableToBorrow`):
- Was: `OWN(asOf) − SUM(active CLs' outstanding_shares **as of now**)` → went negative for any `asOf` predating an active CL.
- Now: `OWN(asOf) − BOR(asOf)` (both read from `account_balances`).

Where do you want me to go from here?

expected.rec_session: Batch all P0s into one commit
